Tracer Master2.0 GS 20”Lowrider Stretch Cruiser Bike
Cruise in style with the Tracer Master2.0 GS Lowrider Bike. This classic stretch cruiser features a sleek design with a spring fork for smooth rides. It’s equipped with single-speed KT coaster brakes for reliable stopping power and an alloy FAT rim with 2.5" front and 3" rear tires for added comfort and stability. The 20"x3.0 BMX tires and Hi-Rise steel handlebars ensure a fun and upright ride, while the Cr-Mo axle bottom bracket adds durability. Perfect for cruising around town or showing off at the next bike meet!
